kjv: Grace be with you … from the Lord Jesus Christ
mine: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us … from Jesus Christ
note: TR "hymon" (you) against "hemon" (us), and adds "kyriou" (Lord); absent from A, B.

kjv: that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive
mine: so that you may not lose what we have worked for, but may win
note: TR first-person "apolesomen … apolabomen" against second-person "apolesete … apolabete" (Sinaiticus, A, B).

kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ
mine: Everyone who goes on ahead and does not abide in the teaching of Christ
note: TR "parabainon" (transgressing) against "proagon" (going ahead; Sinaiticus, A, B); the early text targets those who claim advanced teaching beyond the gospel.
